request: 村民更 Q，按效果图的大头小身体比例；老人孩子保持性别中性。

entries.prompt: Edit target: FIRST image, the standalone blue male villager. SECOND image is the user's strict character shape/proportion reference. Change ONLY the body proportions of the first character to be MUCH MORE CHIBI / Q-cute like the blue male in the second reference: the head including hair should be approximately 48-50 percent of TOTAL character height, about two heads tall overall. Keep the existing face, eyes, sculpted dark brown swept hair, blue crossed tunic, cream cuffs, brown sash, dark shorts, brown shoes and warm upper-left lighting. Shorten the torso strongly (about 25-30 percent) and shorten the legs, make the shoulders narrower and the arms short and soft; small compact rounded body and broad little shoes. The head must feel delightfully oversized relative to the tiny body, not a normal child's body and not a tall doll. Keep a visibly adult friendly villager identity. Let the belt sit close under the chest; very little height between sash and shoes. Preserve natural joint anatomy and clothing folds, do not simply squash the entire image. Do not enlarge or redesign the eyes, do not change hair or costume colors, do not add equipment. Full body relaxed standing idle pose facing screen-right three-quarter, slightly elevated orthographic game camera. Exact smooth richly sculpted 3D-pre-render material and fine clear contours of the reference, no plush fabric fuzz, no pixel art, no black outlines. Genuine transparent background, object fully opaque with only anti-aliased edges, no floor, shadow, labels, text, decorations or frame. All shoes and hair visible with small empty margins. ONE sprite only.

Edit target FIRST image: the existing gender-neutral child sprite. SECOND image is the strict original game art reference. Make this child more Q-cute, with an oversized rounded head and a tiny compact body, matching the original reference's big head / short body proportions. Head plus hair about 55 percent of full character height; short little torso and short legs, small shoulders, tiny hands close to the body, little rounded brown shoes. Preserve the exact soft brown short rounded hair, gentle eyes, neutral face, warm oatmeal-beige loose crossed tunic, cream cuffs, brown sash and loose dark shorts. Shorten the torso and legs, do not vertically squash the face or the whole sprite. Keep the head proportion slightly bigger than an adult villager. The child must remain visually gender-neutral: no beard, no long eyelashes, no hair bows, ponytails, jewelry or strongly masculine/feminine styling. Preserve full body relaxed standing pose, three-quarter facing screen right, warm upper-left light and detailed soft sculpted 3D prerender appearance. No plush fuzzy texture, no black outline, no pixel art. True transparent background, solid opaque character with anti-aliased edge only, no floor or ground shadow, no text or labels. One complete sprite, shoes and hair inside frame.

Edit target FIRST image: the existing gender-neutral elderly villager sprite. SECOND image is the strict original game art reference. Adjust the first character to the reference's big-head tiny-body chibi proportions. Keep the current head and face identity, hair shape and approximate head size, but shorten the body below the chin by approximately 30 percent, with shorter torso and short legs, so head including hair is about one half of total figure height. Compact and round, clearly Q-cute, about two heads tall. Shorten the walking stick proportionally to keep both hands resting comfortably on top and its bottom contacting the same plane as the shoes. Slight gentle elderly stoop, relaxed shoulders, soft elbow bends, tiny brown shoes. Preserve silver-grey short soft hair, friendly slightly creased elderly face, NO beard or moustache, neutral sage-grey loose crossed tunic, cream collar, brown sash and charcoal trousers. This elder must remain intentionally gender-neutral: no bun, jewelry, eyelashes, masculine jaw or gender-coded features. Older age shown by grey hair, gentle eyelid creases, posture and cane, not by making a long thin body. Keep the same three-quarter screen-right orientation, slightly elevated orthographic camera, warm upper-left lighting and smooth rich sculpted 3D pre-render quality. Do not squash the entire image or flatten the face. Do not turn the elder into a baby. Transparent background, opaque solid character with anti-aliased contour only, no ground or cast shadow, no text, no labels, one complete sprite with stick and shoes visible.
